story.title: Vihaan's vehicles
paragraphs_en: Vihaan loves vehicles, he made a book with pictures of different vehicles. He collected pictures of vehicles to make the book "Vehicles".
Vihaan drew a picture of a bicycle and coloured it for his book "Vehicles".
Vihaan found this picture of the red bus in a magazine, he cut it out of the magazine for his book "Vehicles".
Vihaan asked his mom to help him draw the picture of a tractor and he coloured it for his book "Vehicles".
Wow! A truck. Vihaan found this picture in an old newspaper, he cut this picture out of the newspaper, for his book "Vehicles".
This is a picture of a train . Vihaan's his sister helped him to draw and colour this picture for his book "Vehicles" .
Vihaan painted this picture of a scooter for his book "Vehicles".
This is Vihaan's favourite vehicle, an aeroplane. Vihaan's dad helped him to make this picture, for his book "Vehicles".
Vihaan glued all the pictures of vehicles he had collected on papers and made a book "Vehicles". Vroom Vroom Vroom! Vihaan was super excited!
Vroom Vroom Vroom !! "Vehicles". Vehicles Author Vihaan
